## Reproducible failures and visual observation

**R-1 — Guided tow aborts short of its nominal safe mooring.** On the exact built source, import the standalone `saves/attach-tow-command--attached.json` (or identical `replay-earned-tow-attached.json`) through Import & save. The player is already legitimately at the shallow stage and the ordinary collar has been attached. Resume with no movement, allowing about16.2 simulation seconds from tick28427; bounded waits reproduced this in the browser. The hull stops disabled at `(46.22656352979209,-12.938209946420303,-54.22656352979209)` and operation becomesnull. It never reaches `(51,-11,-54)`. Cargo/charge remain intact. Approach locally and patch/ascend to continue; do not edit the save.

The separately labelled exact-source diagnostic reproduces abort at **tick29398,971 steps after attachment**. Bobbin position is the same X/Z with Y`-11.93820994642034`, waypoint0 target `(46,-12,-54)`. Its next movement delta is `(-0.08100328173088477,-0.022091804108423003,+0.08100328173088477)`. `moveHull` reports **hitSolidtrue, hitBoundaryfalse**, hull floor**-13**; the hull does not move. The earlier clear corridor therefore does not prove the full final approach clear. `analysis.json/tow` retains the sampled path, exact abort query and final-pose clearance diagnostic. Root alone assigns any correction. **Nominal tow/mooring completion remains failed.**

**R-2 — The tow-abort explanation is absent from visible UI.** Use the same replay, observe the abort before issuing another command, then reopen Hold. Saved feedback says: “Tow clearance blocked. Dart and cargo remain at this visited site. Approach locally for in-place repair or salvage.” The aborting pure step emits **events`[]`**, and the actual HUD/`replay-abort-ui-snapshot.json`/`captures/10-replayed-tow-abort-hold.png` contain no such explanation. The transponder and local patch remain available. This is a recovery feedback failure; it does not invalidate the later physical patch path.

**V-1 — Nonzero-heading artwork/boarding alignment, separate from reachability.** At saved Dart yaw4.55, `captures/07-nonzero-heading-dart.png` shows the external hull; close approach in `captures/08-close-boarding-prompt.png` places the camera partly inside/behind baseline artwork while the real board prompt is usable. The earlier E range refusal and later successful normal board are both retained. First local patch at yaw1.4 also worked through the normal panel. Root reports a numerically confirmed baseline artwork `+savedYaw` versus Babylon `-savedYaw` discrepancy and concurrent RENDER correction. That is coordination information, **not a retest of corrected render code**. No teleport or visual-geometry workaround was used; final combined visual alignment belongs to root after assembly.
